newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: CRICKET-GANGULY CENTURY HELPS INDIA TO WIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GANGULY CENTURY HELPS INDIA TO WIN.

text.p: A century from Saurav Ganguly inspired India to a 32-run win over the University of the West Indies' Vice-Chancellor's XI in a 50-over limited over benefit match on Thursday.

Ganguly struck nine fours in making 101 off 141 balls as India made 274 for six after being sent in to bat. Navjot Sidhu gave good support with an innings of 70 off 91 balls, including four fours and two sixes.
Sunil Joshi then took four wickets to curb the UWI Vice-Chancellor's XI, who had made a promising start with Shivnarine Chanderpaul making 66 and Brian Lara 57.
Joshi finished with four for 36 off eight overs as the UWI were bowled out of 242 with 2.5 overs remaining. But they lost their last five wickets for only 12 runs.
